title: chain.provider.degraded (schema_version 1)
description: Emitted via the outbox when a provider transitions to unhealthy (R5). Partition key = {chain}:{provider}. Idempotency key = {chain}:{provider}:degraded:{occurredAt}:{UUID} - deliberately NOT the chain:txHash:eventtype format L5 fixes for chain.tx.* events: a provider can degrade, recover, and degrade again, so a fixed key would collide with itself on the second episode against the outbox's own UNIQUE(idempotency_key). This event's idempotency key is passed to OutboxPublisher directly and is not itself a field of this payload body, unlike the four chain.tx.* events above.
